d:
A minor dispute over bursting firecrackers during Diwali turned violent in Baghpat, Uttar Pradesh.
A President’s Bodyguard, Saurabh, was allegedly shot during the altercation.
The bullet got lodged in his head behind the ear and was later removed through surgery.
Saurabh is currently admitted to an ICU in a private hospital in Meerut.
Police have registered an FIR against two accused and are investigating the case.
